name: When should I repair my cabinets versus replacing them entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair my cabinets versus replacing them entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider repairing your cabinets if the damage is localized and minor, such as a loose door, a broken hinge, or small cosmetic flaws. If the cabinet boxes are structurally sound and you're satisfied with the layout of your kitchen, repair or refinishing is often a good solution. Replacement is usually necessary when there is extensive structural damage, severe water damage, or if you want a complete change in your kitchen's layout or style.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair cabinets for minor damage and good structural integrity; replace them for extensive damage or a desired layout change.
